rows.text: ... Can't a girl even catch her breath after defeating a villain?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So hungry...
...Asat Pramad is dead, but he's already nailed the apocalyptic nightmare firmly into the fabric of this world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So, where are we headed next? Who are we fighting this time? We gotta do something, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wanna eat something...
The destination's always been clear. We're heading to Perdido Station.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Calm down, March. Fighting isn't the only thing the Nameless are good for. Leading people safely out of their predicament, now that's a mission even more true to the trailblaze creed than taking down a formidable foe. And that's exactly what we're about to do.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Himeko, are you saying...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The husk's awakening can no longer be avoided, so from now on, we need to use what time we have left to do what the Astral Express does best.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Everyone, I've arrived at the same conclusion.
So, things have really gotten bad enough that we have no choice but to leave?
rows.speaker: Bewildered Refugee

rows.text: I... want a bite...
The husk's activity index is rising exponentially. It's only a matter of time before the seal completely disintegrates.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Isn't there a way to seal it again?
How about we just start a fight with the husk?
How much time do we have left?
Data models indicate: The seal's foundation has been thoroughly disrupted by Asat Pramad's power to manipulate possibility.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I'm extrapolating every known variable. I'm working alongside Graphia and the Stellaron Hunter, but it will take time.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Unfortunately, according to my extrapolations, the success rate of any known head-on engagement strategy is effectively zero.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The intensity of imaginary response from that husk has already surpassed the combined strength of every defensive force we've deployed in this star system. Engaging it head-on would be nothing short of collective suicide.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Based on signal strength alone, it is estimated: The Voracity husk deep within Planarcadia will break through its seal and tear open the World in Canvas in eight system hours. When that happens, the planet Ahatopia will be the first course on the menu once the Aeon's remains awaken.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: And twelve system hours after that... the entire Consternation Starzone will be reduced to a feast for the ravenous.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The Express is the vehicle with the longest known warp range and the greatest carrying capacity. I've already given the order: Perdido Station will clear a priority lane for you. Please proceed to Perdido Station with all haste, allow the refugees to board, and leave Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...Understood. Better brace ourselves for the most packed ride the Express has ever seen.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: We're saved! It's the Astral Express crew!
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: What just happened!? The whole place was shaking like crazy!
rows.speaker: Panicked Refugee

rows.text: The crisis isn't over yet! Hurry, stay with us!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Beep-boop! It's the president!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: Yay, this is great! While the furbos and I were helping the security officers move supplies and keep order, I kept wondering when you'd come back.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You really made it! No wonder you're the "protagonist." Lucky as always.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Thank goodness! I... I thought the president had gone out in a blaze of glory!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: We defeated Asat Pramad.
Is everyone okay?
Woohoo, the president is unstoppable!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: I'm gonna post this amazing news online right now!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Thanks to you, president, everyone's doing great!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: Oh, by the way, what about that Xianzhou General who set out with you?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: To lock on to Asat Pramad's clones, General Yao Guang... was imprisoned within infinite possibilities.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I don't even know if she still... "exists"...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...I see. Her divination came true after all.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: But hey... there's no word she's dead for certain, which means she's definitely still out there.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I... I'll find a way to bring her back. I promise.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I'm afraid now's not exactly the time for this. The ground outside is shaking like crazy. Looks like some big trouble is rearing its ugly head.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I spotted Miss Kuchiba on a call with my creditor, the esteemed Madam Pearl. They were talking about doing a headcount of the refugees and getting everyone aboard the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I'd better head back and help them out. Everyone's pitching in, and I'd look pretty bad just sitting around twiddling my thumbs.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You should go talk to them in the meantime!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Madam Pearl, I have to ask: By entrusting this intelligence to us... what exactly is it you're hoping Mr. Ashveil and I will do?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: What any good security officer and detective should do: keep Planarcadia safe.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Keep Planarcadia safe? We're not even specks of dust in the face of the husk. C'mon, this is way beyond anything a security officer and a detective should be dealing with.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: This isn't where your battle lies. I'll request that the Astral Express take you to Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You've arrived three minutes ahead of schedule. A good omen.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: So, you've got a plan?
Interesting. And what would you have us do? File a petition? Stage a protest? To the IPC in all their superiority, we're not even ants worth stepping on.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: The intelligence I'm entrusting to you both comes from years of personal investigation. It isn't encrypted, nor does it have to be delivered to the IPC's top brass.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I have but one request: protect Planarcadia at all costs.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Perhaps you still remember Jade's invitation: a seven-member summit on the Anti-Destruction Alliance is to be convened in Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I'm hoping the Astral Express can take the refugees from Perdido Station and bring them there.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Before the time comes for the husk to break through the seal, I implore you to report the situation in Planarcadia to the IPC's top brass and ensure that the Preservation's protection is secured.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: ...Secured?
The Preservation's protection?
So it seems you're not sure how the IPC plans to handle the crisis in Planarcadia either?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I know the higher-ups' decision-making all too well. Some of them fit the name "Stonehearts" better than I ever could.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Given the current state in Planarcadia, I wouldn't put it past someone to propose deploying star destroyer arsenals to eliminate the threat once and for all.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Will the Amber Lord... answer our call?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The Amber Lord shall be watching.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: In twelve system hours, the husk will devour the entire star system, and the IPC's decision will serve as an interpretation and execution of the ideals of the Preservation. THEIR weighty gaze will inevitably fall upon here.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: What we need is to tip the balance of IPC's decision-making toward "protection" rather than "abandonment."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Under Qlipoth's watchful gaze, Graphia, Silver Wolf, and I will reenact the "World in Canvas" ceremony to block the husk and buy time before it breaks free.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Madam Pearl, you're not coming with the Express?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: No. My duty lies here. I shall stand with Planarcadia to the very end.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Besides, the artistic realm I've sought for so long is finally smiling upon me. A thousand years ago, Graphia encanvased the entire world in that very same moment of peril. Now that I have another chance to put brush to canvas, how could I possibly let it slip away?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: There's no need to worry about me. I've already made arrangements in Astropolis for the current situation.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I... I don't wanna run away either!

I know. The Nameless have always been brave enough to linger in the direst of plights. Running away has never been your style. But that's exactly why I'm asking you: to bear this decision, the one that's harder for you than any other.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: There is still hope. So long as even a single stroke remains to be drawn upon the blank spaces of fate's canvas, the masterpiece that is Planarcadia will not be lost. And the Phantasmoon Games... are far from over.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No matter how dire things get, we shall find it in ourselves to smile, for this is a ceremony meant to bring joy and miracles to the world.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Yes... there's still hope.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Madam Pearl, I once said that the Trailblaze would serve as the "sail" for the Anti-Destruction Alliance. And so, in times of fierce winds and rough seas, that's precisely when a sail must do its part.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Next, it's time for the Astral Express's war council.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Everyone, we're short on time. Refugees are gathering at Perdido Station, and we need to get them aboard the Express as quickly as possible.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: March, Sunday, I'm counting on you two for this.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You got it! Leave it to me! I won't leave a single person behind!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], once the Express departs, I'll need you to handle navigation and keep things in order onboard.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Haven't you been doing a great job this whole time? From here on out, you'll have to get used to holding the wheel.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As for me, I'm the one who set out from this place, and the one who's come back. This is my fight, and mine alone. I'm leaving Madam Pearl's request in your hands.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Alright. I'll get the Express and everyone on board safely to the next stop. I won't let you down.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hmm, feels like we're back to that very first moment when we boarded the Express. Well then, I'll stay behind and help Himeko maintain the Starblazer.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: In that case, the duty of protecting the Express falls to me. I'll be clearing the lane when the Express takes off.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: One last thing before we depart. Sunday, I have a gift for you.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As the Navigator, I'd like to officially invite you to join the Nameless of the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You could've left at any time, but... thank you for staying with us all the way here.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You may not be one of the Nameless who solemnly swore their oaths upon the Path of the Trailblaze, but I believe the courage you showed standing beside us against Asat Pramad is nobler than any oath ever spoken.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Thank you, Miss Himeko.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Though Planarcadia was not the place I sought, I still believe that somewhere at the end of the road I have yet to walk, there exists something more enduring, something truly worthy of being called an "arcadia".
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: To that end, I'm willing to walk this path with you all, to witness it, and to see it through to the future that awaits us.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Everyone, from this moment onward, we each march toward our own battlefields and fight for the survival of this world. But this is no farewell. I won't say goodbye to any of you, not while we're still walking the same path.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This journey leads us starward!
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Once I've taken care of things in Astropolis, I'll head back as soon as I can.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Attention, all evacuees at the Perdido Station, please form an orderly line and board the Astral Express for immediate transport to Astropolis."
rows.speaker: Stationmaster Meowton

rows.text: "I repeat: Please form an orderly line and board the Astral Express for immediate transport to Astropolis!"
rows.speaker: Stationmaster Meowton

rows.text: There's still a little more time before departure. Make the most of it and say goodbye to your friends.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: A captain would never abandon their ship when it's about to sink, and I won't either.
rows.speaker: Stationmaster Meowton

rows.text: As the stationmaster of Perdido Station, I will guard this place until my very last breath!
rows.speaker: Stationmaster Meowton

rows.text: Holy furboly, imagenae are leaving Planarcadia!?
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: I've heard that imagenae who lose their Wishpower will vanish in the blink of an eye, like takeout left outside Mr. Detective's door, gone without a trace!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: Don't be silly. Your cuteness will definitely get tons of attention wherever you go, people will shower you with Wishpower! Anyway, just remember: It'll be fine. You're not gonna die!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Really? But I'm a journalist! Has it finally come to the point where I have to rely on my looks to get by?
rows.speaker: Furli

rows.text: Are the imagenae really gonna be okay out there?
I can't speak for other places out in the middle of nowhere. But Astropolis? That's where Interastral Peace Entertainment is based! An imagenae there is like a fish back in water.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Th-That's great!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer & Furli & Paraprince

rows.text: We're running out of time, so hop on board, everyone! Mr. Shush has got hot drinks waiting for you all. You'll be safe and sound once you're on the Express!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Medicine, food, thermal blankets... This is the last crate.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Madam Pearl told us there'd be people in Astropolis to receive the refugees, but we should still bring some emergency supplies just in case. Better safe than sorry.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: What's she sending you to Astropolis for?

The Marketing Development Department and the Technology Department left behind one hell of a mess before she took over this world, and she wants to hand over every last shred of evidence she's gathered over the years to us, so we can deliver it right under the IPC's nose.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Never thought I'd end up moonlighting as a deliveryman at the end of the day.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Well, it's not too far off from the Galaxy Ranger playbook, delivering evidence of the bad guys' crimes right to their doorstep, gift-wrapped with a few bullets.
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: Based on what I know about the IPC and how they operate, she's basically handed us a hot potato.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Cross-world law enforcement... that's a bit beyond the scope of anyone's jurisdiction. But judging by the look on your face, I'd say this isn't much of a hot potato at all. More like a ripe, sweet fruit just waiting to be picked.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Everyone, the Express is ready for departure. Please bring the remaining supplies and the last of the evacuees aboard as soon as possible. We need to depart immediately.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...I should get going.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Wait, where are you off to?
Silver Wolf promised Pearl she'd stay behind and help with that "World in Canvas" ceremony.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I don't understand what program code and paintbrushes could possibly have in common, nor do I have any idea what calculations are running through her head.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: She gave her answer... and chose to stay. And so will I. After all, this is exactly why I joined the Phantasmoon Games...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Ever since I received this body bestowed by the Abundance, this is the first time I'm fighting not against death, but to preserve a single moment.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Moments ago, two Fools were strolling down a street at the World's End
It's been a long time since I've allowed myself to act on my own impulses in a world where no script dictates the outcome.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Bladie, take care of yourself.
You too.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Time is short, [Trailblazer]. It's about time for both you and the Express to depart.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I can tell: You still have your doubts.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Are the people who stayed behind safe?
What's your next plan?
How do we keep in touch with you?

...No human force stands a chance against the husk, but Planarcadia itself still harbors many inactive "torn scrolls," fragments of space that are stable. I'll open every safe space we have and order the security forces to evacuate the civilians at full capacity.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I can't make any promises, but you have my word: I will marshal every last bit of processing power and stake everything I have to fight for their chance at survival.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Graphia, Silver Wolf, and I have reached an agreement: We're going to "repaint the boundary."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Using the residual probability disturbances left in the wake of Asat Pramad's dissolution, along with the Wishpower network across the arcadia that hasn't yet been consumed by the husk, we will attempt... to further fold this world inward by one additional layer.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This won't create a haven that lasts forever, it's just a fragile buffer, but perhaps... it can buy us one more minute.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: If things... how do we get word back to you?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Remember the method you used to communicate with Miss Himeko? The signal of the Nameless is always the fastest and most accurate means of communication in the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Rest assured, so long as this world hasn't been swallowed whole... I will receive your information nonetheless.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The road ahead remains uncertain, I can only wish you all the best on your Trailblaze journey ahead.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Attention, all passengers! The Astral Express will be departing in ten minutes! Please board without delay!
rows.speaker: Express Announcement

rows.text: Attention, all passengers! The Astral Express will be departing in five minutes! Please board without delay!
rows.speaker: Express Announcement

rows.text: Open up the tavern!? Sampo, you really think the "World's End" is some kind of public shelter?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: I know, I know. Ever since the tavern was first established, it's only ever had one rule: no entry for anyone but Fools.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: If we just throw the door to the {RUBY_B#tavern}hidden world{RUBY_E#} wide open for anyone, people are gonna be pointing fingers at us.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: But I, old Sampo, look at this flock of lost sheep with nowhere to go... and I gotta say, my heart's aflutter. End-of-the-world survival? Now that's a market with some serious profit potential.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Sampo, you ought to stitch yourself a mask out of credits. If you've got a soft spot for them, just admit it.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: So, it appears our beautiful and kind-hearted Miss Sparxie has some sort of compromise in mind?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Rules may be set in stone, but a Fool is anything but.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: "Tavern Business Cards," special edition! Every single one is laced with my Sparxie Virus. Just scatter 'em around, and whoever picks one up will get a Sparxicle mask!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Brilliant! That basically means everyone's a Masked Fool from now on!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Leave it to me to open the door. Good luck out there.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Alrighty! My dear little Sparxheads, quit moping around, pull yourselves together, and get ready for the next party...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: An even BIGGER bash: the Doomsday SparxiCon!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Everyone's a guest here! Grab a mask if you feel like it. As for surviving the chaos in this tavern... well, it all comes down to how wild a ride they're willing to have!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Wh—What's the deal with these people!? Did Sparxie let them in again?
rows.speaker: Panicked Fool

rows.text: Darnit! Sampo, who told you to open the tavern door to these regular people!?
rows.speaker: Panicked Fool

rows.text: Easy there, young fool. Around here, we extend a little grace and a little courtesy to anyone wearing a mask.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Besides, I won't be sticking around here for long. Old Sampo will be taking them somewhere safe.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Let old Sampo think for a second... Where should our Doomsday Tour Group take our new friends for a little sightseeing? Lushaka? These old legs can't afford to get rheumatism on top of everything else. Planet Screwllum? Those Intellitrons are way too cold... Wait, cold?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Aha, I've got it! Stick with moi, everyone! For only ten credits each, I'll take you somewhere with absolutely gorgeous scenery!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: The Belobog Tour Group is officially open for business!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Board the Express
Hold on a moment
I got separated from my child...
rows.speaker: Grieving Refugee

rows.text: Same with my father, and he's getting on in years...
rows.speaker: Sympathetic Refugee

rows.text: Our home... it's gone.
rows.speaker: Anxious Refugee

rows.text: It'll be safer in Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Comforting Refugee

rows.text: How are we supposed to make a living once we arrive in Astropolis?
rows.speaker: Bewildered Refugee

rows.text: Will they even take us in?
rows.speaker: Bewildered Refugee

rows.text: "Express system diagnostics in progress. All passengers, please remain calm and stay where you are..."
rows.speaker: Express Announcement

rows.text: Is everyone okay?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: I'm fine.
For a moment I thought I was a goner back there.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I think... I'm getting a little motion sick.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You're lucky you can even feel motion sick! We almost didn't make it back there!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: D—Did you guys see that giant hand sweep past the window...? It just came down from the sky and swatted the Phantasmoon away...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: I wasn't paying attention to that. All I saw was Dan Heng and Miss Himeko fighting to clear a path for us.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Conductor, what about things over in Planarcadia... Is everything okay?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Relax. So long as no one's in a rush to charge headfirst into the beast's maw, your friends still have time to hold their own against the husk.
What's going on? Who's talking!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom & March 7th

rows.text: Asat Pramad!?
[Trailblazer], why would you bring something like THAT back here!?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Asat Pramad said it counts as a "prize."
How was I supposed to know it could actually talk...
I heard that too, but I never thought you'd actually have the guts to take it.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's the head of a Lord Ravager we're talking about here!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's hard to say whether Asat Pramad's head is that hand... or this die.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: We've got enough trouble as it is. The Astral Express does NOT welcome it.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Dear conductor, don't you think that's a little harsh?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Thanks to YOU, the Express has had more close calls with death than Pom-Pom can count! Don't make Pom-Pom find a blender and turn you into a smoothie!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: ...It's all over now, Conductor.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I'm just a die left behind by {RUBY_B#Isee}Asat Pramad{RUBY_E#}, a harmless toy that can't even move on its own.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Ah, Isee... How did things end up like this?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Life is full of surprises, I suppose... Sorry for all the trouble I've caused you.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: To make up for everything I've caused the Express... how about I go back to my "old line of work" as Isee?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: You might think of me as a little teaching tool. Whenever the young Trailblazer needs some tempering or craves a little excitement on a dull stretch of the journey, just toss me up in the air!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Just as I always have, I'll bring you a one-of-a-kind "Trial of Probability." After all, learning to stay true to your path amidst chaos and the unexpected... that's one of the most important lessons for the Nameless, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Roll a 1, and I'll generate astral charts plotting a course straight to the Antimatter Legion's Warforge!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Roll a 2, and for the next hour, every beverage on the Express will be replaced with high-energy fuel or Vonwacq's iron-eating stomach acid...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Alright, stop it already.
Please just find a rag and wrap it up.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: I can tell, back when Isee the Starseer was around, the Nameless never lacked the opportunity to go on an adventure.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Times have changed. Passenger [Trailblazer], with Himeko away, you'll need to step up and take on the role of acting Navigator.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: I won't let you down.
That'd be good!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Calibrating the warp jump to Astropolis is gonna take a little more time. Why don't you head to the Party Car and check in on everyone?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Those passengers who just escaped must still have their hearts in their mouths. Go bring them a hot drink and say a few comforting words. Let them know that now they're aboard the Express, everything's going to be okay!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Leave it to us, Conductor.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Daddy, where are we going? I don't wanna go out anymore. I wanna go home to Mommy...
rows.speaker: Bewildered Child

rows.text: We'll go home soon, I promise...
rows.speaker: Father Forcing a Smile

rows.text: Little one, I'm afraid we'll have to find somewhere safer. Um, think of it as... being a brave explorer for a little while.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Explore...?
rows.speaker: Bewildered Child

rows.text: Even heroes in stories have to retreat sometimes before they can find the weapon to beat the big bad monster. So we gotta be brave, wouldn't you agree?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ...Mm-hmm! I'm gonna be a brave explorer!
rows.speaker: Bewildered Child

rows.text: Some people look miserable, others are crying. The mood around here feels so heavy.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Their homeland is about to be destroyed by some unknown catastrophe, and they're being forced to leave everything behind, far from home, to a strange world on the other side of the cosmos. Everyone's on edge, not knowing what the next moment might bring.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What are we supposed to do?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Fear is contagious. It spreads from one person to the next. One person cries, and ten more start to panic. Let me try using my tuning to soothe these people.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...Strange. I can't sense their feelings anymore.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: The power bestowed upon me by the Mask of Elation... It's gone? Is it because we're outside of Planarcadia now?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You got this, "protagonist"!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This time, we're on our own.
Tuning might relieve them from panic for a while, but it won't help them see the situation for what it really is.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: These people don't need some lofty, out-of-reach promise. All we need to give them is a clear, safe "next step."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ease their fear of the future
So... where we're headed... is it safe?
rows.speaker: Hesitant Youth

rows.text: I know how it feels to be uprooted from your homeland on such short notice, heading to a world you've never seen... It's only natural for people to feel scared.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Our destination is hardly some dangerous, uncharted wasteland. Astropolis is one of the major worlds under the IPC, equipped with comprehensive shelter facilities and legal protections.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Not only will everyone be safe there, but you'll also be provided with temporary housing and living supplies. Once the crisis in Planarcadia has been resolved, the IPC will arrange for each one of you to be returned home.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Really? You sure those bigwigs at the IPC won't just treat us like a bunch of rats and slam the door in our faces?
rows.speaker: Resistant Woman

rows.text: Madam Pearl has already arranged everything properly.
Madam Pearl has already arranged everything for you all.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: {F#Planarcadia's}{M#Planarcadia is} a member of the Pan-Cosmic Trade System. The IPC has an obligation to ensure the safety of Planarcadia when it faces a crisis.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Everyone, our friend [Trailblazer] here has some serious connections with the bigwigs in the Strategic Investment Department!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I'm sure you've all heard the story of how {M#he}{F#she} fought for the interests of Jarilo-VI, haven't you?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: When the time comes, you'll have to schmooze Jade for us!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ease their worries about home
I know that some of you still have loved ones back in your homeland, and some are grieving for all that it's been through.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: But Planarcadia is still standing! Its light still shines on the Express's astral charts!
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Because there are still many brave souls fighting on that land: the Nameless, the Stellaron Hunters, the Masked Fools... and of course, Madam Pearl.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: But is there truly any way to stop those things crawling out from underground...?
rows.speaker: Sorrowful Young Woman

rows.text: We'll pull through this!
Everyone, the Astral Express just took down a Lord Ravager! And the ones still there in Planarcadia are none other than [Trailblazer]'s most trustworthy companions.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I have faith in them, the same way I have faith in everyone here in this car right now.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: They haven't given up on this world. We cannot allow ourselves to be overcome by fear or despair!
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Everyone, once we reach Astropolis safely, we can bring the crisis in Planarcadia to the attention of more powerful forces across the cosmos. And when that happens, everything taking place on this planet will receive the reinforcements it desperately needs.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And that's what this journey is all about: carrying the spark of hope out there for those fighting the good fight!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Astropolis... I've heard of that place... It should be safe...
rows.speaker: Whispering Crowd

rows.text: With [Trailblazer]'s strength... {F#she}{M#he} wouldn't lie to us, would {F#she}{M#he}...?
rows.speaker: Whispering Crowd

rows.text: We need to get the children out... The Astral Express...
rows.speaker: Whispering Crowd

rows.text: Nice work, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now that the tide of panic has receded, everyone's got... well, a solid rock to stand on, to say the least.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: All thanks to the three of us working in perfect sync.
I have to say, your ability to deliver a speech is... unexpectedly impressive.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Heh, guess I'm more silver-tongued than I look...
Oh really? So all those times you don't talk, you're just acting cool?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: In any case, we can deal with whatever trouble the future throws at us after we get to Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Attention, everyone, calibration is complete. The Express will be warping to Astropolis shortly. For your safety, please find the nearest seat and buckle up.
rows.speaker: Express Announcement

rows.text: Ah, sounds like the conductor's all set. Let's grab a seat.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So that giant cube is...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Attention, all passengers, the warp jump is complete. We have arrived safely at Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Express Announcement

rows.text: Finally, we're here.
So... what are we supposed to do next?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ugh, Himeko and Mr. Yang always make it look so easy, like it's just step one, two, three. But now that they're gone, I end up completely flustered.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's start with the war council first.
As per tradition, every time the Express makes a stop, we Nameless gather first to decide on our next course of action.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Incoming encrypted transmission from Astropolis...
rows.speaker: Comm Channel

rows.text: Looks like our discussion will have to be put on hold.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Friends of the Astral Express, you're finally here.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I've been receiving intermittent hyperspace transmissions from Pearl. I'm now up to speed on the emergency in Planarcadia, where the husk is about to break free.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Himeko... and Madam Pearl, are they okay?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Based on the timestamps, they were still fighting as of right before your arrival here.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I'll authorize landing clearance for you immediately and have someone sent to receive you. Welcome to Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I've also made proper arrangements for accommodating the refugees. Please have the representative from the Department of Aberration Defense coordinate with them.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: It's rare to see Madam Jade without a trace of a smile on her face.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Well, you know what they say, the fewer the words, the bigger the trouble.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: *sigh* I'll go notify the conductor and get the docking car ready.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And I'm going to inform Miss. Nihilux, Mr. Ashveil, and Miss Kuchiba. We'll need their help getting everyone settled in.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Friends, the docking car is standing by and ready to roll!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's head out once you're all set.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So... this is Astropolis?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Trampolines, beach volleyball, and the smell of barbecue wafting in from who-knows-where... Guess this is what vacations are all about...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We just barely escaped with our lives, and now we're suddenly greeted by this scene of peace and prosperity. It feels surreal... like stepping back into Penacony all over again.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: For the people of Astropolis, the events unfolding in Planarcadia still seem like a distant affair.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It's hard to imagine what will go through their heads when they hear the news of the Voracity husk's revival.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: From what I know, even if the news spread far and wide, most people in Astropolis would carry on surfing, sipping coffee, and dining on elegantly plated meals at open-air restaurants without batting an eye.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: After all, this is the vacation resort for IPC executives. Once people get parasitized by a certain kind of power, they always have this delusion that the fire will never burn its way to them.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: The refugees on the Express can't just sit around twiddling their thumbs. We need to report this to the Astropolis authorities ASAP. Just leave that to Mr. Ashveil and me.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Sounds like a plan, now let's get moving. And don't forget to bring Mister N along. His brain works faster than the two of ours put together.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Wait, take me along too! Everyone's got something to attend to. How can I just sit here doing nothing?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Um... well, that won't be necessary. You see...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Oh right, as the Astral Express's biographer, your comic's still running, isn't it? You wouldn't want to miss out on the Express Crew's adventures in Astropolis, would you?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...Fair point. But I can't just keep being a "walking camera", can I?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Miss Nihilux, we understand how you feel. But the work Ashveil and I have ahead of us is... incredibly tedious, and we'll no doubt be up against Astropolis's massive bureaucratic machine. Please just leave all the bickering and legwork to us.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Those two acting all hush-hush... Are they on some kind of secret mission or what?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Madam Jade said she'd send someone to receive us... So where's the guy?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey... Hellooo...
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: I've been waving forever and you didn't even notice me! It's me, your avian buddy, Owlbert!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Did you guys see that!? One of the cars just came flying out like a surfboard...
rows.speaker: Onlooking Crowd

rows.text: Who are these people?
rows.speaker: Onlooking Crowd

rows.text: Surprise! Didn't see that coming, did you?
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: It's only been a minute. How did he just vanish like that?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Mr. Owlbert!? What are you doing here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: After all those episodes of Keeping Up With Star Rail, don't tell me you still didn't know the show's physical studio is right here in Astropolis!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Do you have any idea how hard it was for me to get away from my mountain of work? All because Madam Jade asked me personally to come pick you up. Figured an old friend of the Astral Express would do the job best.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: What's she being all secret about anyway? I'm a pretty big deal in Astropolis, you know! C'mon, can't you give me just a teensy little hint...
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Hoot, hoot, hoot, I see! Sounds like a hoot... not that I give a hoot! The only hoots I give are literal ones. Anyway, I'll pry no more!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Wordplay? Seriously? At a time like this? Unbelievable!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why are there security forces here?
rows.speaker: Passersby

rows.text: Word is someone's resisting arrest.
rows.speaker: Passersby

rows.text: Easy there, young lady. There's no rush, just follow me! We'll cut through the Kenneth Seaside Park, and Madam Jade will be waiting for you somewhere a little more... convenient.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: In the meantime, allow me to give you a grand tour of the City of Converging Stars along the way: its sights, its culture, the whole shebang! Shall we?
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Speaking of which, why is this place called the Kenneth Park?
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Ta-da! The answer is: The administrator of Astropolis is named Kenneth Arita, and he's the one who designed this seaside park!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Alright, we're not here for sightseeing. Can we just put the tour guide act on hold for now?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The IPC shall triumph! The IPC wins it all!
rows.speaker: Madam House

rows.text: You wanna talk about rebels? Nobody out-rebels ME.
rows.speaker: Auto Heartthrob Bot

rows.text: There are three things I shall never do...
rows.speaker: Chrissas the Great

rows.text: Dirty work, hard labor, and anything dangerous!
rows.speaker: Chrissas the Great

rows.text: Here we are! Just head up this way, and Madam Jade's waiting for you on the hotel terrace.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: The "Tide of Terminator" Grand Hotel, huh? So this is the spot Madam Jade picked? Pretty tucked away, I gotta say.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Wait, you've been here before, Miss Blurry?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: After waiting around for a short while, the shuttle bound for Lodestar Tower arrives at the station.
Heh, well, I did actually live here for a while back in the day.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You know how it is. As a comic artiste, my greatest talent is traveling around the world, alternating between "field research" and "deadline crunches."
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Whew, every time I do an interview, I can't help but envy you guests who get to travel far and wide and rack up all those amazing experiences. *sigh*... Sadly, work is like an invisible birdcage that I just can't seem get away from.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Well, the mission Madam Jade assigned to me is all wrapped up. Much as I hate to say goodbye to you all, I gotta be on my way and get back to recording the show.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Haha, before I head out, I hope you don't mind me asking, [Trailblazer]. Since you've graced Astropolis with your presence, would the Keeping Up With Star Rail production team have the honor of interviewing you and your friends?
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: If the opportunity comes up...
I'd love that.
[Trailblazer] just casually dropped the politest rejection ever...
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: I sincerely hope that the opportunity comes sooner rather than later.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Really!? Th-That'd be GREAT!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Well then, I'll take my leave. Hope your chat goes smoothly.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Let her stay.
You can trust Nihilux.
We'll never abandon our friends...
...And we definitely won't abandon Planarcadia.
Is this Yabuli's doing?
Imagenae can be born in Astropolis too?
Where can we find him?
Will he even meet with us?
I'll talk Arita around.
I won't let things get to that point.
What kind of people does Jade send into the field?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Probably people who are good at staying under the radar, I assume?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: There's no time to think about all that.
I'm sorry, Mr. Owlbert...
We must see him, no matter what.
Bring the furbos along to the office.
Oh right... This is my first time teaming up with you, huh, Sunny?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Missing Dan Heng already? Don't worry, I'll try not to hold you back.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Is the meeting spot somewhere around here?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wait, that figure!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is that you? Skott!? You're still alive??
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Did I say that?
I didn't do that.
That's nonsense!
That's enough small talk.
We still have important matters to attend to.
Who would've thought your single act of kindness would transcend worlds... and come to our aid.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: That was hardly some act of kindness... I should've kept my mouth shut.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Right this way, if you will.
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: An anti-gravity corridor? It feels like I'm back in a Penaconian dream.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Even back when I was still alive, a place like this was a rare splurge for me.
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: A restaurant that truly lives up to its name. The view here is quite spectacular.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: In Penacony, whenever the stock market fluctuates, plenty of people will head up to high places for a little... "mental recalibration." Does Astropolis share the same custom?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: So, where's Arita?
A bigwig like him is definitely dining in some secluded private room. Probably surrounded by bodyguards, too.
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: Let me go scout ahead for you. Wait here.
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: Wait a minute, is that... Asta?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Oh my, [Trailblazer]? What a pleasant surprise!
rows.speaker: Asta

rows.text: What are you doing here in Astropolis?
What do you mean? Astropolis is my hometown! I've mentioned it before, haven't I? Quite a few people in my family work for the IPC.
rows.speaker: Asta

rows.text: I racked up a bunch of vacation days at the space station, so I figured I'd use them and come home for a visit. Plus, it gives me a chance to handle some... collaborative matters on behalf of Madam Herta.
rows.speaker: Asta

rows.text: What about you guys? Here for a meeting with the IPC? Or... on vacation?
rows.speaker: Asta

rows.text: More or less... We've got some urgent business to take care of.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Then I won't keep you any longer. But... if you need anything at all, like booking a table, arranging a visit to the Cloudpeak Level of Lodestar Tower, anything like that, just let me know.
rows.speaker: Asta

rows.text: After all, sometimes connections get you further than regulations on IPC turf. Good luck out there!
rows.speaker: Asta

rows.text: Where'd Skott run off to? What's taking so long?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let's go check on him.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Strange, there aren't even any bodyguards around here.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Do those shades look familiar to you?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wait, they appear to be Mr. Skott's... What exactly happened here?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Mr. Taravan has concluded his meal. Items consumed during this dining session: one hundred portions of Prime Tomahawk Steak, thirty blocks of Dragon Scale Cheese, ten servings of Emerald Mushroom Salad, assorted Lushaka Blue-spotted Sashimi, and Gold-Flake Wine.
rows.speaker: Robot

rows.text: Taravan? That's... quite the appetite. And you are...?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I am Mr. Taravan's personal dietary management robot. My duties include monitoring his blood pressure before and after meals, and ensuring he takes his high-potency digestive enzymes and gout medication.
rows.speaker: Robot

rows.text: My regards to you both. All for the Amber Lord... and that eternally bottomless dinner table~
rows.speaker: Personal Health Butler

rows.text: Wash your hands before you eat, rinse your mouth after the treat. Good health makes for a happy life~ yoho~yoho!
rows.speaker: Personal Health Butler

rows.text: So, this isn't some private room for Mr. Arita at all.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You guessed correctly, Penaconian exile.
Please don't blame your poor ghost friend. His idea of stealth isn't nearly as impressive as he thinks, and neither is his brain.
With just a little bit of misdirection, he dutifully led you straight here to me.
Of course, I wouldn't be so bold as to let you disturb Mr. Taravan's meal without permission.
I only have five hours left...
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Kenneth Arita, of the Traditional Project Department.
Traditional Project Department... Arita?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: So you're Mr. Arita?
You're not Mr. Arita, are you?
How could that be? I'm merely an adopted son, fortunate enough to bear the old gentleman's family name.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Oh, why of course not. I'm merely an adopted son, fortunate enough to bear the old gentleman's family name.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: If you think of all of Astropolis as one big, sprawling family, then I'd be the "butler" of the household.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: And a butler's job is to know everything that goes on within the estate down to the smallest detail, and to ensure no pests ever find their way inside to threaten the family's interests.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: I heard that the Astral Express had arrived in Astropolis... three Nameless bringing a flock of refugees to beg for aid. Curiosity got the better of me, so I decided to come and take a look.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: And the result turns out to be... disappointing.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: I'm sorry, there must've been some misunderstanding between us.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Mr. Kenneth, we have an extremely urgent matter and would like to request an audience with Mr. Arita.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: This is not your fault.
Mr. Arita has already made his position clear to everyone: no lobbyists. The lady from the Strategic Investment Department behind your visit should know that all too well.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: My father taught me that at the heart of every deal lies one thing: respect.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: But that lady showed no regard for Mr. Arita's wishes, sending bumbling spies and reckless lobbyists. Her actions were utterly devoid of respect.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Kenneth, we're not spies, nor do we mean to offend you. We're just... a group of desperate people with nowhere else to turn.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: My friends are back in Planarcadia, and every living being in that world, are in grave danger right as we speak.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: On behalf of the Astral Express, I make this promise to you, and through you, to Mr. Arita: So long as he is willing to cast the deciding vote against the weaponization of the husk, the Express will bear any and all costs and obligations that arise from it.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Please, make sure this promise reaches him.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...The bond you share with your friends is truly moving.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: However, I'm afraid I can't do that.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Skott, you got that right!
Huh? Really!?
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: As for this spy right here, I can give him back to you.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: "The heart of every deal lies in respect." Chew on that. I've said my piece.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Taravan, that bloated pig... Weaponizing the Voracity? Why not just weaponize himself instead? Save everyone the trouble...
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: So, what do we do now?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I'm sorry, [Trailblazer]. I... I messed everything up again.
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: An unfavorable opening, to say the least. The moment IPC faction politics get involved, things get infinitely more complicated.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: [Trailblazer], what do you think? Should we try a different approach, or keep up the chase?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...He seemed to be hinting at something.
There's still hope.
You mean what he said to us before he left?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: But where exactly is that hope you're referring to?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I can reach out to Owlbert and feed him a bombshell for his Keeping Up With Star Rail.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's time to relaunch Furbobo Weekly and drop our first bombshell scoop!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "The heart of every deal lies in respect..." Is Kenneth trying to tell us something?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Respect? Since when has the IPC ever treated anyone with respect?
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: Setting everything else aside, my higher-ups are each more ruthless than a wolf, which is very much in line with my family motto: "No friends. Only prey." Who knows, maybe we're even distant relatives?
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: A wily old fox like Arita, does he even know what respect means? The only way he'd ever bow is if Louis Fleming crawled out of his coffin, I'd say.
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: True respect comes from having the strength that others acknowledge.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Just like how the Strategic Investment Department respects the Astral Express... Kenneth is telling us he wants to see what we're made of.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I see... But what do we have that could earn his respect?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Trying to bribe him would take wealth on Old Oti's level to sway Arita. As for using force... that would be exceedingly unwise on IPC ground.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Intelligence and influence are power in their own right.
As far as the city is concerned, the awakening of the husk is still a piece of information known only to the IPC's upper echelons.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: But Astropolis isn't home to IPC executives alone. It's also teeming with envoys, magnates, and officials from member worlds across the Pan-Cosmic Trade System.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Exactly. The crisis Planarcadia is facing right now is going to seriously shake their confidence in the IPC. What's that old saying... when one limb suffers, the whole body feels the pain.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So, once we release this information to the public, the IPC's stock price is going to be thrown into turmoil.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: We don't necessarily have to convince Arita. We can use information the way... Fulwish did.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Once you start learning from the enemy, it's hard to stop, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: So, we leak this to the press and turn this little internal scheme into an "external risk" that the IPC has no choice but to deal with.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: H—Husk? Stock fluctuations? I... I have no idea what you're talking about.
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: Uh... I think I'll pass. I just got a new lease on life, and I'd like to enjoy it for a few more days!
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: A—Anyway, I gotta run!
rows.speaker: Ghost Skott

rows.text: Now then, let's have Kenneth show a little "respect."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: C'mon, Sunny, let's head to the Lodestar Tower and meet up with March and the others.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...March 7th disturbing the peace? You've gotta be kidding me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: We can still make it in time if we make haste.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: It's just one thing after another.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is Kenneth creating obstructions for us?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: No way? He left us a hint...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So the Marketing Development Department is behind this?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: What's going on over there?
rows.speaker: Passersby

rows.text: Apparently there's a wanted criminal walking among us.
rows.speaker: Passersby

rows.text: I see them. They're right there.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Disturbing the peace"... Is this a mistake?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We're guests invited by Madam Jade of the Strategic Investment Department. Is this really how Astropolis treats its guests?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Your entry permits are verified and valid. However, the laws of Astropolis are jointly upheld by the seven major departments. No exemptions are granted based on the invitation of a single senior executive.
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: Our system detects a dangerous wanted fugitive hiding among your visiting party.
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: Is this some kind of interastral joke? The Nameless of the Astral Express are heroes who've saved many worlds...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This is bad. We need to go, now.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Target identified: Sunday, former head of Penacony's Oak Family, currently a high-priority wanted criminal of The Family. Charges include "severe endangerment of cosmic order and security."
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: Since when does the IPC hunt down wanted criminals for The Family?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: In accordance with the Pan-Galactic Civilizations Judicial Mutual Assistance and Emergency Extradition Treaty, IPC security forces are authorized to subject dangerous fugitives to preventive detention, to ensure segmentum stability and fulfill treaty obligations.
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: Aw, c'mon, please don't make my life difficult.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: It appears explaining myself is entirely pointless now.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I refuse!
You want to take a member of the Express? In your dreams.
Excuse me. I am not equipped with a dreaming module.
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: You have selected the most unwise course of action: violent obstruction of the law.
rows.speaker: Defense Sentry

rows.text: Warning. Disarm immediately. Noncompliance will prevent us from guaranteeing your right to life.
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: Ah, that's the stuff... clashing with the local authorities every three stops of the way, how familiar.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Lighthouse! Execute the arrest directive immediately!
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: Zip it, tin can! You're making my brain hurt.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Huh? What's going on? Why is he taking down his own people?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We're counting on you, then.
Alright, stand down. I'm not here to cause trouble.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Here, this is a special access pass. Its clearance is a few grades higher than that outdated arrest warrant of yours.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I'm taking them with me. Objections?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: ...Clearance confirmed.
rows.speaker: Astropolis Sentinel

rows.text: *Astropolis civility*... Hilarious, "clearance confirmed." One word of objection out of you, I'll be pounding you into scrap and shipping you back to Security in a box.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Right, you lot. Write your own incident reports. Make it airtight, and keep my name out of it, hear me?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Well don't just stand there. Do you really want to waste eternity dealing with these by-the-book blockheads?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I am "Lighthouse"! Astropolis's Honorary Security Officer.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I am the light that pierces the darkness, the shield that guards against danger, the one who leaves no place to hide for the scoundrels that threaten IPC assets and the safety of Astropolis's citizens. I am the BANE • OF • EVIL!
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: See that gleaming statue? They built it for me after I single-handedly stopped an out-of-control airship from crashing into Paradise Island three years ago, saving well over a hundred IPC executives and more than a thousand foreign dignitaries from our partner worlds!
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I wonder what it looks like inside.
You'll see for yourselves soon enough.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: It's so tall... like a space elevator.
Cool.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So, you're basically Astropolis's resident superhero?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Superhero... Pfft, I'm no different from the influencers swarming this city. I can't hold a candle to the Nameless of the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: At the end of the day, I'm just a corporate grunt running errands for the bigwigs...
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Someone sent me to bail you out. As guests of the Strategic Investment Department, you all have free rein in Astropolis. With the exception of that Halovian young master over there.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: The IPC is riddled with internal factions. It seems someone is trying to assert their presence.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Spot on. I got two calls at the same time. One asked me to "ensure unrestricted access for the Strategic Investment Department's guests," and the other asked me to "Apprehend the high-risk wanted felon."
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I thought to myself, isn't this just *Astropolis civility* picking on the little guy? Am I supposed to fish the sugar out of their instant coffee, too? But hey, that's just how corporate life is...
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: So tell me, big hero, exactly which two heavyweights are duking it out up there?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: On IPC turf, some questions are better left unasked. Because the real question isn't "who dunnit," but rather "who wants you to know."
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Nope.
And I, obviously, haven't received the directive to "tell you."
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: To think my past mistakes would catch up with me right here, right now. [Trailblazer], March, I'm very sorry. Imposing my presence here will only burden you.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: So be it. No need to worry, Mr. Lighthouse. I will leave Astropolis immediately.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Where could you go at a time like this?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'll return to the Express and warp to low orbit above Planarcadia. There I can use the Express as a comms relay. We need firsthand intel from there.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Take care, you two. I'll do my part, and you do your best too.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Phew... finally got His Highness out of my hair. My performance review is safe. I'll call that a win.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Honestly, I never want to set foot in this dump ever again.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hehe, it's truly my greatest honor that you Nameless are so willing to cooperate.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: By the way, I hear you're heading to the Lodestar Tower. Please, allow me to escort you the rest of the way. I guarantee no one else will come looking for trouble.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Escort... or surveil?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: In Astropolis, surveillance is a public service. Me? I'm just the optional companion package with a more personal touch.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Ah, that white tower piercing the clouds...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's right. That's the "Lodestar Tower," the central headquarters of Astropolis and the main office complex for all the different divisions.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Ah, it seems this isn't your first time in Astropolis, my lady.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: From afar, it might look like a prickly needle, but it actually houses a staggering number of IPC employees, along with their dreams and entire lives.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Look all the way up to the top of the tower. See? That floating island is called "Cloudpeak." It's home to the richest and most powerful big shots in the IPC.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Looking at it now, it doesn't resemble a needle so much as a strand in a spider's web of power. And to climb that strand... you'll need more than strength. You'll need skin thick enough to stop a bullet, and the willingness to put your soul up as collateral if that's what it takes to meet your KPIs.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Yet, countless people still rack their brains and do whatever it takes to claw their way up this strand, hoping to reach the top and live like gods alongside those media giants.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: What about you?
I have no interest in that kind of life.
That's the Nameless for you. No interest in fame or profit... must be nice. Me? I'm not nearly that selfless.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Five years ago, when I first came to Astropolis, I wondered... if one day, my statue would stand atop "Cloudpeak."
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: And how'd that turn out? It ended up in the plaza over there, becoming the most glaring... signpost on the path to "Cloudpeak." Just a daily reminder to everyone passing by: Look, it's the superhero "Lighthouse." This is as far as he got.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Speaking of which, after defeating Irontomb, did the IPC give you guys, um, some kind of special bonus?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: My bad, my bad. I was projecting my own situation onto you. You guys are heavy-hitters who can go toe-to-toe with the heads of the Strategic Investment Department.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Why would folks who can trade blows with a Lord Ravager sweat the small stuff?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Do you have a lot of that "small stuff" to sweat over, Mr. Lighthouse?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If only. My typical to-do list looks more like this: track down some big shot's runaway nosewalker, then stop two departments' private security forces from shooting each other, while somehow managing not to step on anyone's toes.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: You're quite the down-to-earth hero.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Down-to-earth? Yeah. If I so much as brush against some big shot's favorite painting or antique vase while on a mission, I'm stuck writing a 3,000-word incident report.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Your superhero career sounds a little... miserable.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's life. Misery is the main flavor, with just a dash of sweet every once in a while. Heh.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Alright, now that we've taken in the view, we should all be feeling less uptight, more relaxed. Let's head over to the Lodestar Tower.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: This is my first time getting up close and personal with the Nameless of the Astral Express. What an honor.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Want an autograph or a photo? Wait, you're not trying to get a selfie with us for clout, are you?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How many voted in favor of weaponization?
How many of them are on our side?
No, no, no! Of course not! I'm just genuinely curious and a huge fan!
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: This poster...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah, that's a promo poster for the Cosmic Big Lotto.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: What, wanna buy a ticket? Haha, I get it. Everyone dreams of striking it rich overnight.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: No, I mean the person on the poster.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah, Beatrice Mellanine. Apparently this insanely lucky girl hit the grand prize three times in a row.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Does someone that lucky actually exist?

Who knows? I heard the IPC tore their pipelines apart looking for a glitch, found nothing, and had no choice but to honor the payout. They even signed Beatrice as the spokesperson for the Interastral Big Lotto.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Man, if only I had that kind of luck.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: It's here. Let's go, guys.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Alright everyone, grab a spot and hold on tight.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: This little hover-saucer is gonna coast along the tow track for a bit before taking us into the Lodestar Tower.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Hold on tight! Once we're through this tunnel, we'll be there.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Is Mr. Lighthouse really escorting us all the way inside?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sorry, but I'm the one with the special clearance.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I've gotta deliver you VIPs safely to your destination. My mission isn't complete until then.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I'm usually just flying around up there, so this is my first time riding an everyday commuter shuttle.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: If you folks aren't in a chatty mood, I can stop talking.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: It looks like a needle from the outside, but once you're inside it's actually massive!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're looking at at least a hundred thousand people buzzing in and out of here on any given day.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Non-employee detected in the work zone. Please cease movement and submit to scanning.
rows.speaker: Bathyoculus

rows.text: Identity confirmed. Security Officer "Lighthouse." Invited guests, Nameless [Trailblazer], March 7th, and... unidentified unemployed individual.
rows.speaker: Bathyoculus

rows.text: Who are you calling unemployed!? I'm an independent comic artist currently dodging deadlines!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Suspicious target. Requesting... requesting security forces.
rows.speaker: Bathyoculus

rows.text: Again? Is there seriously no end to the IPC's red tape?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Special access permit, authorization code 54266.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Authorization confirmed. Welcome to Lodestar Tower. Please abide by the IPC code of conduct.
rows.speaker: Bathyoculus

rows.text: Great idea. I've been sick of these *Astropolis civility* monitors for ages.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Don't sweat it, they can't touch you. At most, they'll just angrily bill the damages to the Strategic Investment Department.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Listen up, you *Astropolis civility* eyeball freaks, I've got a special transit pass right here. Code 54266.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I don't care if you can understand me, but here's a free piece of advice: don't mess with these guests from the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: But...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I know you have a lot of questions, but the hallway isn't exactly the best place to chat, is it?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This way. B7-03, right?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Heh, back at my old stomping grounds. I know this place like the back of my hand.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This elevator's taking forever... How many floors does this place even have?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Lodestar Tower tops out at 6,622 floors... I'll never understand why they built it so ridiculously high.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: B7-03. This should be it.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Oh c'mon, it's literally just a sad little storage closet.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Finally, a place to catch our breath. So, you two, should we kick things off with a pre-battle briefing...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ...or would you rather get those burning questions off your chests?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Uh oh, not good...
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department

rows.text: Taking the liberty to intercept people on Oswaldo's behalf...
rows.speaker: Strategic Investment Department Employee

rows.text: That's the end of the road for our careers.
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department

rows.text: You've got some serious nerve, Yannick.
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoy

rows.text: To actually forge Mr. Oswaldo's orders...
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoy

rows.text: We've all been played.
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoy

rows.text: Before we begin, I have a question.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: From the day we met, your identity has changed constantly: President of Furbobocom, an employee at Pearluxe, a deadline-dodging comic artist... and now, you're the IPC's Lotto Goddess?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So, Miss Nihilux, who are you really?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Before I answer that, I need to ask you two one thing: You're willing to trust me, right?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You seem like... a good person, I guess. But if you don't give us some straight answers, [Trailblazer] and I are gonna have a hard time trusting someone who's always keeping secrets.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haha... "the nice guy card." March, that's the highest praise I've ever received. It's fine. A trusting heart is magic. Since you're willing to trust me, I'll stop hiding things from you.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I do juggle quite a few identities, and I'll admit, I don't exactly look like the most reliable person.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: But every single version of me is one hundred percent genuine. I'm just glad these identities have allowed me to help my friends out when they're in a pinch.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Little raccoon, there's something I need to get off my chest. I think it's time I told you...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Boss! Evil boss! Mr. Sunday tipped us off that there's some explosive news to cover, so we came without a moment's delay!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: ...Explosive news?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sunday and I have an idea on how to get an audience with Arita.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Uh-huh. So, you want to blow the "Planarcadia Husk Crisis" wide open, using public outcry to corner the pro-weaponization faction?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Even in my wildest dreams, I never imagined Furbobo Weekly would one day expand into interstellar reporting.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: So what are we waiting for? Let's drop this bombshell on every reader in Astropolis right now!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This is the exclusive of all exclusives! The bombshell of all bombshells!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Beep-boop! A—Are we really gonna publish something like "IPC higher-ups want to turn a planet into a weapon"...?
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: What if... Furbos gets stuffed into a courier box tomorrow and tossed into a black hole!?
rows.speaker: Furli

rows.text: Listen up, little dummies. If we don't hurry and get this massive scoop out, our newsroom in Planarcadia is gonna get eaten by monsters and dumped into a black hole anyway!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Remember the journalism principles I taught you? Don't write the news like some bone-dry, fact-finding report. The headline has to be sensational and intimately connected to our readers' everyday lives.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: "SHOCKING! Secret Meeting of IPC Execs: Save the Planet, or Turn It Into the Ultimate Weapon!?" Like this?
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Exactly. But the point isn't to expose the conspiracy, it's to shove the "danger" right in our readers' faces.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: They need to know that after Planarcadia falls, the world they live in will face the exact same threat.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Subtitle: "Exclusive Insider Report: Astral Express Tells All! A Greater Shadow Looms Over Astropolis!"
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: I got it! We can also add a poll question to the article like, "Do you support 'Encanvas Rescue' or 'Weapon Modification?'" Maximum interactivity!
rows.speaker: Furli

rows.text: Nice. Aside from our little furbos' over-the-top, clickbaity articles, we'll also need you to step in front of the camera for a few shots to boost the story's credibility.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: We'll aim to infect every social and news platform in Astropolis in record time with this news, just like the Anti-Organic Equation did.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Alright, my mission ends here. What was it you guys were planning to do next?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Madam Jade said she set up an office for us.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Then just go say hi to the receptionist and drop Madam Jade's name. Assuming none of the bigwigs decide to trip you up again, of course.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Good luck out there. I've got a patrol to get back to.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: See ya, Mr. Lighthouse.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Leave it to us furbos! For the freedom of press... And to keep our home from turning into a giant firecracker!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer & Paraprince & Furli

rows.text: The news is out! The furbos blew their entire marketing budget buying up prime ad space and sponsored trends across all platforms.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Now, all we have to do is wait for it to gain traction.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: We only have three system hours left. If we fail to make it before then...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Alright, my mission ends here. What was it you guys were planning to do next?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Madam Jade said she set up an office for us.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Then just go say hi to the receptionist and drop Madam Jade's name. Assuming none of the bigwigs decide to trip you up again, of course.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Good luck out there. I've got a patrol to get back to.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: See ya, Mr. Lighthouse.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Alright, my friends, let's not stare anxiously at the clock. This is the home of Interastral Peace Entertainment, after all! One system hour is more than enough for a message to burn from a tiny spark into a raging wildfire!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Given the endless roadblocks we've faced so far, I'm having a hard time relaxing...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do you think the IPC's PR risk department will immediately take action and silence us?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Miss March, please don't say another word. Because I think you just jinxed us!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Huh? That fast!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Beep-boop! Aberrant data detected! The initial click and share metrics across all major platforms are skyrocketing!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: B—But! None of the related discussion topics made it onto the trending lists!
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: It's like hitting an invisible wall! The IPC is definitely pulling the strings!
rows.speaker: Furli

rows.text: What, giving in to despair already? Did you forget? Astropolis is home to more than just IPC employees, and not every employee is a puppet dancing on the IPC's strings.
rows.speaker: Nihilux
