rows.text: Algorithms and push notifications are crucial, sure, but when everybody's safety, and the safety of the entire universe, is at stake, it's not just the algorithms alone that determine how the news spreads.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: At the end of the day, the ultimate medium through which information spreads is still people.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Terrified whispers, burning curiosity, the desire for the truth... these will all run rampant in breakrooms, cafeterias, and on commuter trains, all through the oldest and most effective method there is: word of mouth!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: The IPC can bury trending searches and throttle notifications, but they can't wipe every private message, nor can they stop people from wondering "what if" in the back of their minds.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Nihilux, what did you want to get off your chest...?
No, it's nothing. Let's save my story for later. Once I start talking I'll just ramble on and on, and we don't have that kind of time.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Let's focus on the life-or-death situation in Planarcadia first!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Oh, right!
All we have to do is make sure this first spark is bright, and true! And the little furbos have already nailed that part.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You recount your encounter with Kenneth Arita, along with your thoughts on the matter.
So, what do we do next?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That is a question the IPC itself must answer.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: The fire has been lit. Putting it out is their problem.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: After a while, the Furbo Journalists set up their computers and got ready.
I'd guess the most dignified and foolproof approach would be to come straight to the source of the information, and propose a partnership.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: See? What did I tell you...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Ahem... [Trailblazer], Miss March 7th! Hello there! It's me, your old pal Owlbert!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: The higher-ups have seen the bombshell news you just dropped.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: What are they saying?
Who saw it?
Well... they're taking it seriously, of course! Extremely seriously!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: C'mon, old friend, you know how it is. Obviously, some big boss from "up top."
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: So, they've decided to set up a special, last-minute interview session just for you, at the Panorama Hall, inside Lodestar Tower! They want to hear all about the situation in Planarcadia firsthand, along with your demands.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Remember to include a poll.
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! IPC higher-ups and even business reps from other star systems will all be there! You'll get to speak directly to the most influential audience around!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Yours truly is also all set to conduct an exclusive interview with you afterwards!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: You will show, right?
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: [Trailblazer], leaving already?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No time to waste. I need to move now.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Good luck!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How much time do we have left?
The Panorama Hall... should be around here somewhere.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Can I really convince those bigwigs...? And how will the Marketing Development Department people react?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Forget it. I need to stop overthinking.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So many screens...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Welcome, [Trailblazer].
Pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am Yannick, assistant to the Interastral Peace Corporation's Board of Directors, and one of the hosts of the "Pan-Cosmic Trade Summit."
The news you posted on your {RUBY_B#{TEXTJOIN#254}}personal media{RUBY_E#} has caused a massive uproar across all of Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: I have been commissioned by the board to arrange a special discussion panel. We would like to invite you to speak your mind, without reserve.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: ...I have to speak to all these people at once?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Looks like we can't count on the Strategic Investment Department, either.
There is no need to be nervous. Most of them are only here to listen.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Everyone's closely following developments in Planarcadia and the Voracity husk. Your testimony will help them understand, and it will factor into any potential re-evaluation of the Board's position.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: If you are ready, please follow me to the central platform.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Please try to capture people's attention and make the most of it.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Today's meeting agenda, is...
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoy

rows.text: Lowering the IPC consumption tax rate for the Taikiyans.
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoy

rows.text: But this Planarcadia incident threw a wrench in the works.
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoy

rows.text: Ah, guess we'll have to table this for next time.
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoy

rows.text: No idea who called this meeting...
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department

rows.text: It clashes with Mr. Zazzad's schedule.
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department

rows.text: The boss of the Strategic Investment Department is not going to show, either.
rows.speaker: Strategic Investment Department Employee

rows.text: They might need to be careful about the optics because of Pearl, from what I heard.
rows.speaker: Strategic Investment Department Employee

rows.text: Everyone, please quiet down. A messenger from Planarcadia, Nameless of the Astral Express, [Trailblazer], is here.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: At present, aside from Zazzad and Diamond, who are absent due to scheduling conflicts and other unforeseen circumstances, the heads of all seven IPC departments have remotely connected to the "Pan-Cosmic Trade Summit" venue.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: According to the pre-meeting briefing, our agenda today is: an inquiry and statement of position regarding the Planarcadia husk crisis.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: (Don't panic. Seize this chance to get your demands across to these IPC executives...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I am sure you have all seen the news regarding the situation. I swear on the honor of the Astral Express that everything I say is the truth.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I am here to deliver a plea on behalf of everyone still fighting in Planarcadia{F# at this very moment}.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I seek to invoke the power of the Preservation to encanvas Planarcadia once more, buying us more time against the husk's breakthrough.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I hope the executives holding voting rights will consider the future of Planarcadia, as well as the worlds of all the envoys present here today.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let's start with this: the husk has been sealed within Planarcadia for over a millennium. Why did it suddenly spiral out of control?
rows.speaker: Madam Scarred Eye

rows.text: The "Phantasmoon Games" held in Planarcadia are in fact a ceremony designed by the Aeon of Elation to suppress the husk.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Unfortunately, despite our best efforts to stop him, Lord Ravager Asat Pramad managed to disrupt the ceremony.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I understand you're anxious, but I think you're being alarmist. You're telling me that in twelve hours, the Consternation Starzone, where Planarcadia is located, will be wiped out? Do you have any proof to back up your claim?
rows.speaker: Taravan

rows.text: A few IPC executives, along with trade ambassadors who traveled here from other star systems.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Every single one of them, {M#sir.}{F#madam.} I represent their collective will.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: ...I am not an expert on leviathans. My conclusion is based on the calculations of Madam Pearl from the Strategic Investment Department.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: As the administrator of Planarcadia, her conclusion should be reliable.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Unfortunately, neither of you are experts. Let me be clear: the Voracity has been dead for a very, very long time. By your own account, Planarcadia is nothing more than one fragment of its corpse.
rows.speaker: Taravan

rows.text: The Technology Department's assessment has concluded that the IPC's cutting-edge technology is more than capable of controlling the activities of these Aeonic remains... and perhaps even turning them into our most powerful weapon.
rows.speaker: Taravan

rows.text: As for the people there, they're collateral damage. You can't do business without taking any loss.
rows.speaker: Taravan

rows.text: Mr. Taravan, what are you saying? If you adopt the Technology Department's proposal, wouldn't you be abandoning Madam Pearl... along with all the survivors?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Isn't Planarcadia part of the IPC's trade network? What happened to the spirit of "Preservation" the IPC preaches?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You've just told every trade ambassador in this room that the IPC's "protections" and "treaties" are worthless the moment disaster strikes.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Esteemed ambassadors, I ask you: when the next disaster descends upon your worlds, can you trust this person standing before you to help?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hahaha! Don't bother with the theatrics! Of course they don't trust me, nor should they.
rows.speaker: Taravan

rows.text: They're here for business. They're here to sell their manpower, resources, and technology. They're here to trade their planets' blood for sky-high amounts of money!
rows.speaker: Taravan

rows.text: Every world that joins the trade network bears its own risks: the Swarm, the Anti-Organic Equation, the borisin... Sure, the IPC provides some support to its allies, but the IPC isn't your spoon-feeding, diaper-changing nanny!
rows.speaker: Taravan

rows.text: Ahem. That's quite enough, Taravan. You've made it all the way to board director, yet you seemed to have more professional discretion back when you were hauling materials for the Building Material Logistics Department.
rows.speaker: Madam Scarred Eye

rows.text: Feeling amused? You lot are pathetic.
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: Weaponizing the husk is the most effective, technologically sound solution to the crisis right now. Bar none.
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: Representative of the Astral Express, you should be well aware that the Strategic Investment Department's proposal has one fatal flaw: encanvasing Planarcadia merely hits the pause button on the crisis. It doesn't end it.
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: When the seal completely fails, not even shattering all ten Cornerstones would buy the Ten Stonehearts a single second of breathing room. How do the Strategic Investment Department and the Express plan to respond when that happens?
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: Alternative plan or no, I have to ask...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is there really zero risk in turning an Aeon's fragments into a weapon?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Risk? Of course there's a risk. But it comes down to probability. You don't expect me to explain the technical details right here, do you?
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: Yes, it comes down to probability. You may think that a chance buried several decimal places deep is effectively zero. But have you ever faced an enemy that can truly manipulate probability?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I have. Lord Ravager Asat Pramad. He can make guaranteed hits miss their mark, and turn a one-in-a-million disaster into an absolute certainty. You think the risks are under control, but against him, or another higher being like him, that's nothing but an ignorant delusion.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You certainly can turn a blind eye to the odds, and hit that "weaponize" button.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But when that "probability" turns around and devours you, will you be ready for it?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Fair enough.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: I've heard all I need to know regarding the Planarcadia issue.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: So it seems Mr. Arita is backing the encanvasing proposal for Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: Murmuring Voices

rows.text: I support the encanvas plan, and that's that.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Too bad Zazzad and Diamond didn't show up. That was exhilarating!
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department

rows.text: I'm guessing they already knew how this discussion was going to end.
rows.speaker: Traditional Project Department Member

rows.text: Congratulations on getting your wish, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: The discussion was quite lengthy. Let's take a break.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: We actually convinced Mr. Arita...? I thought it'd take a lot more work.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Everything happened too fast. I don't have a more fleshed-out idea.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But if we can delay the crisis, we'll have more time to figure out the best solution.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I understand. In certain moments, a matter of life and death can carry the exact same weight as a speck of dust. Until the dust settles, people are bound to feel a lingering sense of unease.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: But the truth is, you've been fighting for the right cause, and you've succeeded in moving it forward.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Hey, remember your old friend Owlbert? He's been following the summit from start to finish. Perhaps during the break, you could head over to the Keeping Up With Star Rail studio and update the audience on the results of the discussion.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: True, I promised Owlbert I'd record a segment after the summit.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The court of public opinion is a battlefield, and seizing the initiative is crucial.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Keeping Up With Star Rail reaches an audience far beyond Astropolis. It broadcasts to the entire cosmos. It's a prime opportunity to make your voice heard and leverage media influence to pressure the IPC's decision making process.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: This ring platform we're now standing on branches out in three directions, leading to different functional zones within the Lodestar Tower. The Keeping Up With Star Rail studio is right over there.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: If you'd like to head over, simply operate this rotary dial and the path will open right up for you.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Before I head out, I should tell March and the others the good news.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Better not keep them worrying.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Finally, I can take a breather.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Next up, Owlbert's interview... Better not keep him waiting.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Here we are. The studio.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Amid a flurry of chatter and debate, the Pan-Cosmic Trade Summit came to a close.
Seems like there's nobody around?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Are you [Trailblazer]? Hi! Looks like the summit talks have wrapped up.
rows.speaker: On-Site Employee

rows.text: That went surprisingly well.
It's great to meet you, [Trailblazer]!
I'll be filling in as the host for this episode of Keep Up with Star Rail! You can call me Little Owlbert.
Owlbert isn't coming?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Well... since you broke that massive scoop, he's got a ton of big shots to interview. Tight schedule, heavy workload, you understand, right?
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Why don't we go ahead and start recording?
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: First question: Just what kind of impact did the Voracity's husk make on Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: I heard the Strategic Investment Department did massive reconstruction work there! Does that mean all their investments went right down the drain?
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: You make a great point! Whatever's going on over there, at least one thing's clear: retirement-related investments have definitely gone down the drain!
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Why, do you ask? Well, an apocalypse obviously tanks everyone's life expectancy, so eldercare brands have absolutely no future!
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Seriously? What are you doing? You need to take this seriously.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah... In my hosting experience, a whole show without a single laugh is a complete train wreck!
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: We're talking about the existential crisis of an entire world. This isn't Keeping Up With Star Rail's style at all...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: {M#He,}{F#She,} Nameless of the Astral Express, the hero who saved Amphorous...
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Uh... Huh?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And now, for the crisis-ridden... Planarcadia? {M#He}{F#She} braved Astropolis, delivering an impassioned speech at a star-studded "Pan-Cosmic Trade Summit"!
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: How will {M#his}{F#her} voice influence the direction of this summit? What destiny awaits Planarcadia? Dear audience, please welcome today's guest on Keep Up with Star Rail...
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Would Owlbert really hand over the hosting gig to a bird like you?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Tell me, who sent you?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ms. Nihilux! Good news! [Trailblazer] just sent us a message!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Old Mr. Arita has been won over! He's going to vote for "encanvas"!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Isn't this all a little too easy?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Is that a bad thing? Come on, don't be like me. I really don't want to play the jinx anymore.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Alright then, March. Congratulations!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Furbos!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You scared this furbo half to death! Evil Boss, don't just start screaming!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: In the meantime...
My little dumbos, get online right now and pull the search volume for the keywords "Summit," "Astral Express," and "Planarcadia."
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Huh? What for?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: In my experience working at the IPC, you can never be too careful.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: They invited [Trailblazer] to present {M#his}{F#her} case at the summit. Even if they don't publicly announce the voting results, they can't stop curious outsiders from driving up the search volume for related info.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Beep, boop! Th—these keywords are showing absolutely zero search fluctuations! The search volume is so low... it's sad.
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: ...Ugh, I've got a bad feeling about this.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Right, let me check the scheduled meetings for today...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Look at this! Today's reservation record for the Panorama Hall says "Closed all day for internal equipment maintenance."
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: What do you mean, "closed all day"? Isn't [Trailblazer] supposed to have an interview there? Ah... I see.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You've got some nerve, Oswaldo... to pull such cheap stunts before a magician.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Magic?
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Yeah. An elaborate, high-budget display of... commercial magic. Its goal isn't to solve the problem, but to buy time.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Ha... hahaha! Brilliant! Absolutely brilliant! I was starting to think this little performance would drag on boringly until the end of the world!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: You old creep! You knew!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Watching smart people walk step-by-step into a huge glaring trap is way more fun than pure destruction!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: So, how much time do you have left to write a slightly less embarrassing ending for this farce? An hour? Or only the relentless countdown to detonation?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I need to message [Trailblazer] right away!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ms. Nihilux, where are you going? I'm coming with you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No, March, you stay put. The Marketing Development Department might be keeping a close eye on anyone going in or out of this room right now. I'm not part of the Express Crew, so I won't draw as much attention.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Using a highly convincing "executive debate" to stall our "protagonist," tricking {M#him}{F#her} into thinking hope is just around the corner so {M#he'll}{F#she'll} quiet down and wait for the outcome.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Besides, I've got Beatrice Mellanine's ID card here, so slipping in and out will be easier for me.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Oh, right. Mr. Asat Pramad, since you enjoy being a spectator so much, why don't you step onto the stage yourself? See firsthand how this farce you indirectly started goes completely off the rails.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Heehee... you don't look so good all of a sudden. Are you tired?
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: You all... teamed up to play me like a fool.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Uh-oh! The mission's a bust...
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: I—I'm sorry! I'll talk! I'll tell you everything! I'm just a lowly grunt in the Marketing Development Department! They promised me a promotion and a raise if I could keep you here!
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: You can get lost now.
Actually... neither of us is going anywhere. They've locked down the entire studio and the corridor leading to the Panorama Hall. The doors won't open for anyone until the scheduled time.
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Meanwhile, in the Keeping Up With Star Rail studio...
Fine. They went through all the trouble to set this up, I might as well grace the stage and crash the show.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Mmph... mmmph...
Owlbert?
I've gotta, I've gotta, I've gotta stall {M#him}{F#her} for as long as I can. Or I'll end up like Mr. Owlbert!
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Where is Owlbert? Is he still alive?
I heard he regretted making that call... he wanted to contact you.
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: So the security guards locked him up in one of the studios.
rows.speaker: Little Owlbert

rows.text: Do the math! Is that measly paycheck really worth throwing your life away for?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Did Oswaldo put you up to this?
[Trailblazer]? D—Don't come any closer! I don't want you to see me like this.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: I'm so sorry, *whimpering*... I knew they were just using me to gain your trust, but I—I still made that call! I'm a spineless chicken!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: They locked the doors. Do you know another way out of here?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Yours truly knows a way! There's an express lane for clocking out right in the corner of the studio!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Found it? I'll give you two passcodes. Punch them in, follow the path, and you'll be able to bypass the lockdown and cut right behind the Panorama Hall.
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Hurry up and go! Don't worry about me! I can break out of this cage on my own!
rows.speaker: Owlbert

rows.text: Take care of yourself.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I thought your "Madam Scarred Eye" impression was pretty spot-on. You really nailed that mean streak.
rows.speaker: Mocking Male Voice

rows.text: Your "Taravan" still takes the cake. Wonder if the Building Material Logistics Department is going to send you a cease and desist?
rows.speaker: Mocking Female Voice

rows.text: [Trailblazer] probably isn't coming back here, right?
rows.speaker: Muffled Female Voice

rows.text: Judging by the time, I'd say our job here is done?
rows.speaker: Muffled Female Voice

rows.text: Better safe than sorry. Let's keep up the act a little longer.
rows.speaker: Muffled Male Voice

rows.text: A cheap but effective trick.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What... is this place?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: With [Trailblazer] out of the way, the mission's basically complete. What happens next depends on how long the fake host can keep {M#him}{F#her} distracted.
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department?

rows.text: Let me check the access logs... The locks were overridden! Who did this?
rows.speaker: IPC Employee

rows.text: That'd be me. I did it. Someone gifted me a tiny data slice, said it'd take care of a lot of headaches.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Stellaron Hunter tech. Pretty impressive, huh?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Are you... a Stellaron Hunter!?
rows.speaker: IPC Employee

rows.text: Oh no no, I'm your colleague. Beatrice Mellanine. Haven't you heard of me?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It's time for the lies and the farce to end.
Mellanine... isn't that name from almost fifty years ago?
rows.speaker: IPC Employee

rows.text: Enough chit-chat! Call security, now!
rows.speaker: IPC Employee

rows.text: A—Are we going up against a Nameless? Aren't they partners with the Strategic Investment Department?
rows.speaker: Security Soldier

rows.text: Quit yapping! You have one job: follow orders and open fire!
rows.speaker: IPC Employee

rows.text: That's a wrap for your show. Now it's my turn to take the stage.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hold your horses, "protagonist." It's not your time to shine just yet.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: These small fries aren't worth our time. Let someone with a big appetite gobble 'em up!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: W—What the heck is that?
rows.speaker: IPC Employee

rows.text: "Hello! Please support the IPC! All for the Amber Lord!"
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: Out of my way!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I completely understand your anger and distrust. Were our positions reversed, my reaction would likely be far more explosive.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Everyone involved in this charade will face the severest of punishments, I assure you.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Get lost!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: H—Help! The Nameless has gone crazy...!
rows.speaker: Security Soldier

rows.text: Slack off once in a while! It's good for your health!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Alright, that takes care of that!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: As satisfying as it was fighting our way through them, the problem we're trying to solve still remains...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You know, those fakes in the meeting were a bunch of nobodies with zero actual pull. Oswaldo, the mastermind behind this whole farce, is still hiding comfortably behind the scenes with no intention of showing his face.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ...Holy Aeons! Who the heck let {M#him}{F#her} out!? Weren't we supposed to stall {M#him}{F#her} for at least one system hour? What happened to the door locks!?
rows.speaker: IPC Employee

rows.text: We can't let him, or any of those other high-and-mighty executives keep stalling us endlessly.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Got any bright ideas, Ms. Nihilux?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I noticed you've been holding onto a pretty dangerous trophy. Forgive me for taking the liberty, but I brought it along.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Oh? What do you need me to do? Slaughter them all, or... bankrupt them?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Just look at this. The severed head of a Lord Ravager, and it still talks.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I guarantee you, shoving this in their faces will shock them through and through. More than some distant husk breaking its seal ever will.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I like this idea!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...The "executives" all logged off early, huh.
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department?

rows.text: Off the record: don't you folks think I'd be a pretty convincing "Taravan," too?
rows.speaker: Strategic Investment Department Employee?

rows.text: When it comes to being a gourmand, I could give the real Mr. Taravan a run for his money. Burp~ Hahaha...
rows.speaker: Strategic Investment Department Employee?

rows.text: Alright, zip it! If word of this gets out, you'll be packing your bags by tomorrow morning!
rows.speaker: Secretary of the Talent Motivation Department?

rows.text: But Mr. Yannick promised us whatever is said during this summit won't reach a single ear outside the Panorama Hall.
rows.speaker: Strategic Investment Department Employee?

rows.text: Oh, yeah? Are they really that confident?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} [Trailblazer], please don't get so worked up.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Stupefied Crowd

rows.text: How is [Trailblazer] back?
rows.speaker: Stupefied Crowd

rows.text: Yannick, you sneaky little bard's turd! Point every single camera at me right now! I know you have the clearance.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I want my face broadcasted to every single screen in Astropolis!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I tried to present my case calmly and peacefully, but all I got in return was mockery and humiliation.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: If the news of "Planarcadia's impending destruction" is too far removed from your daily lives to pique your interest...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Then how about this?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The severed head of a Lord Ravager!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Every time it rolls, it brings incalculable variables and trials to an entire world.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Care to test your luck? Will disaster befall you? Or you? Or every single one of you?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...I've heard the crew of the Astral Express are all honorable, righteous Nameless. You wouldn't do such a thing.
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Would you?
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Even if you do resort to violence, Astropolis has its own superhero. I've already signaled Lighthouse... He'll be here to save us any second now!
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Pathetic. It seems you neither comprehend the power of a Lord Ravager... nor know how to treat a true hero with the dignity they deserve.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: A true hero doesn't hold a bomb and threaten to blow the entire place sky-high!
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: ...We meet again, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: It's a real shame. This time, I've received a top-priority directive: "Eliminate the threat to the venue at all costs."
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I know I'm no match for you. But this is my duty, and the sole reason I wear this power armor...
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I have to maintain the peace in Astropolis, because I am the Honorary Security Officer, Lighthouse!
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: ...Peace? Since when has Astropolis ever known peace?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I once heard a rather amusing joke: "The Preservation" is nothing but a facade, Qlipoth fell from grace ages ago, and the IPC is actually a faction of "the Voracity."
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: But seeing it for myself today... it turns out it wasn't such a joke after all.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: There is a leviathan of the Voracity slumbering right beneath Astropolis, too!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: What kind of nonsense is that thing spouting!?
rows.speaker: Taikiyan Envoys?

rows.text: Okay. It's okay. Don't panic! It is impossible for a Lord Ravager to breach Astropolis!
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: Do it, Lighthouse! Take them all down!
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: What an absolutely... spectacular show, Yannick.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Mr... Kenneth?
rows.speaker: Yannick

rows.text: [Trailblazer], Madam Nihilux... Or perhaps I should call you Madam Beatrice Mellanine.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: I am here to welcome you both with the utmost "respect." Please, follow me to the elevator. We are heading to the "Skycall Aery."
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: That is Mr. Arita's private residence. It is secure and quiet. It is there that he will decide the future of Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Please allow me to solemnly clarify: I swear upon the Amber Lord, the upcoming meeting has no pre-arranged script.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Father is already aware of the commotion here, and wishes to meet with you both.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Heh. So we really did have to tear down the stage and blow the roof off just to get the boss's attention.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Lead the way, Mr. Butler.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Please follow me.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Where are we?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The entrance to the "Cloudpeak" Skycall Aery. Nice view, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: From up here, all of Astropolis is laid bare, stripped of its secrets. Not many are privileged enough to enjoy such a view.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Right this way, you two.
rows.speaker: Kenneth Arita

rows.text: Take the Cloudbearing Elevator to the Hall of Five Senses
rows.speaker: Kenneth Arita

rows.text: Take whatever leverage you have, use it to persuade Father.
rows.speaker: Kenneth Arita

rows.text: In the entire IPC, only seven individuals hold this honor.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: There's no one here.
If you would both step onto the platform. Should you experience a touch of vertigo, please don't be alarmed.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: We have arrived.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Father, I have brought them.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Let them approach. You are dismissed.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Children need not be present for what comes next.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Oh, is it going to be R-rated? Too bad we're on a tight schedule.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: There's less than a system hour left before you cast that crucial vote. Clock is a-ticking, Mr. Arita.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You really should invest in a better watch, Ms. Mellanine. We have time to spare.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: We all know Louis Fleming only needs sixty seconds to make a decision.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: You're not Louis Fleming, though. Everyone also knows...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ...That even the chairman can't change a decision made by Ol' Arita.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Indeed. The younger generation seems to think the Ahatopia case requires no further discussion.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: I, however, have my reservations. I find both of the current proposals lacking.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Both lacking?
Oswaldo is capable and ambitious, but he remains a child. His ideas are naive.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: "Diamond"... His mind is far more mature than his appearance suggests. But being overly calculating can sometimes be a detriment.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: My duty is to select a successor for the IPC. Their credentials are simply too shallow to claim my vote.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: And so, [Trailblazer], I am in need of a third option.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: A third option?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I have been observing you ever since you set foot in Astropolis. Hustling and making your voice heard... You're just like Louis Fleming during the founding years.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: With everything going on, you're still playing power games?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I don't care about the IPC's twisted logic. I need your vote...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Now, I will give you sixty seconds. Tell me your story. If it proves compelling enough, you might just win my support.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: This way, I won't be forced into a binary choice, and you get exactly what you want. A win-win, as they say.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Listen closely.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I'm not here to tell stories. Stories are just word games, and they won't stop the imminent threat of the Voracity breathing down our necks.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: If you think "encanvasing" is just stalling for time, and "weaponization" bears too much risk...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Then I'll give you your third option.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The first signs of the war among the Aeons are beginning to show. I believe this is why the IPC has been positioning itself here for years.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: When I saw the Phantasmoon at its fullest, I became even more certain. This ceremony to commune with the Aeon, whether genuine or not, could be the turning point that determines the destiny of the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But what's important is that you make your own decisions. Such as... whether you'll take part in these grand games, and if so, how.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Return to whence you came...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: As a Supplicant, I shall restart the Phantasmoon Games!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I'll gather our Wishpower, seek an audience with Aha, and use the Elation's authority to suppress the husk, just as it was done countless Amber Eras ago. If people could do it then, we can do it now.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: But for any of this to work, Planarcadia has to survive.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And what makes you think the ever-fickle Aha will simply grant your wish?
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Right back at you.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What makes you so certain Aha won't take my side?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hmph. Fair enough.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: I don't make a habit of dealing with Aeons, so I suppose I have no say in the matter. Then again... I'm not the one making the decision here.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Louis Fleming is.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Sixty seconds are up. Chairman, the decision is yours.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: How many Amber Eras has it been?
rows.speaker: Louis Fleming

rows.text: My old friend, have you returned?
rows.speaker: Louis Fleming

rows.text: You're asking too much.
Regardless of the identity you wear now...
rows.speaker: Louis Fleming

rows.text: ...As long as the party concerned approves of this young one's proposition, the IPC will lend its full support.
rows.speaker: Louis Fleming

rows.text: So, tell me. What are your thoughts?
rows.speaker: Louis Fleming

rows.text: [Trailblazer] is gone. Will everything {M#he}{F#she} claimed actually come to pass?
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: {M#He}{F#She} will do it. {M#He}{F#She} has to.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Do you really need to ask?
When have I ever opposed any of "Akivili's" ideas?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: The answer is "approved"! The writing is on the wall. It's quite obvious whose side I'm taking.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: In that case, as always, I wish you both the best of luck.
rows.speaker: Louis Fleming

rows.text: Arita.
rows.speaker: Louis Fleming

rows.text: Yes, Sir.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: By the sacred authority bestowed upon us by the Amber Lord, the Traditional Project Department has reached a decision.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: We cast our vote for the Astral Express. Encanvas Planarcadia, and restart the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Ms. Himeko! It's time to retreat!
rows.speaker: Soldier

rows.text: ...No. Perhaps we don't need to head to the tavern after all.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The series of tremors... have now subsided.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The tentacles surging from the fissures have vanished, too.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's [Trailblazer]. They actually did it.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I am delighted to deliver the good news: the re-enactment of the World in Canvas ritual was a success. Planarcadia has survived its most critical hour.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Really!? So the crisis is averted?
rows.speaker: Soldiers

rows.text: Everyone, the Astral Express has... reached the outer perimeter of Ahatopia's crystal wall... The train will serve as a relay station... bridging communications between Planarcadia and Astropolis...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I bring greetings from [Trailblazer], along with our objective for the next phase.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Make your preparations. The final Phantasmoon Games... are about to begin.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: As you wished, the Amber Lord has protected Ahatopia.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: I am sure you two have private matters to discuss, so I won't intrude. But before I take my leave, the IPC has one final request.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Please leave that "die" to us.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Sure is a long way from the ground. A fall from up here would shatter you to pieces, no?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Better to risk the fall than be ground into the dirt.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Rather than being crushed silently underfoot, most would gamble to reach the summit. At least they get to see the view from up on high.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Make that nine! I'm here too, even if I am just riding your coattails.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: The guest, or the main course? Most people don't know which category they fall into, until the moment they reach the table.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: A Lord Ravager's head is far too dangerous. It needs to be properly contained.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Let's do as he says. This old gentleman is trustworthy.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Besides, I'm guessing you must have a mountain of questions right now...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: And having a third wheel around when we clear up all that confusion would totally kill the vibe.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Oooh? Why is the air in this room suddenly thick with conspiracy?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Could it be that someone struck a little side deal under the table?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Times change. The IPC may no longer be the support team of old, but we won't abide the slander of a pawn of Destruction.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: Your accusations at Lodestar Tower certainly piqued some interest. And from none other than the subject of those rumors herself...
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: The "Leviathan of Astropolis" you spoke of... she is here.
rows.speaker: Arita

rows.text: What do you intend to do with the die, Ms. Yabuli?
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Oh, me? Can't you guess what I want?
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: Hand it over to Lighthouse and send it to the Life Sciences Institute. I'll take the scalpel to it myself, dissect this head stuffed full of conspiracy theories...
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: ...And devour the "knowledge of Oroboros." Every last crumb of it.
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: I have a lot of questions for you.
What exactly is going on? I'm so confused!
I saw through everything. I was just waiting for you to come clean yourself.
Sheesh, way to leave me hanging.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Nihilux should be right around here.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I knew you'd come.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: To you, my dear audience, I dedicate this performance. I wonder, did it bring a little more elation into your lives?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: If it didn't...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Shhh, that's exactly how it should be. Because the grandest act of the play is only just beginning.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It's a past I can barely stand to look back on. A wrong turn I took when I was young and foolish.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Those days entangled with the gods... A swirling blur of peach-pink and blood-red. Looking back on it now... it was an absolute nightmare!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: But now, for the sake of the entire universe, and for you, I am willing to take off my mask.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I am the master of phantasia, the one who mourns, the murderer of all "certainty," and the false sovereign of all "theatrics."
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: The first Fool, and the original Actor.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Hi?
You startled me.
